draftBefore.emotion: wide-eyed and thoughtful, contemplating the vastness of everything
notes: The Russian word 'мир' is a homonym, meaning both 'world' and 'peace'. In older Russian, these were spelled differently to distinguish the meanings, but in modern Russian, they are identical.
When referring to 'the world' in the sense of the planet or humanity, it is synonymous with 'свет' (light/world), but 'мир' is far more common in everyday speech.
